notes: Zoom is a HARD CUT punch (instant static scale change ~1.0<->1.15 at sentence ends / pauses) — NEVER an animated/gradual zoom.
Always word-level running captions (karaoke sub) — the video must never ship without them.
NO b-roll, NO cards/overlays: pure talking-head footage + captions + punch-zoom only.
NO sound effects on cuts (no whoosh/swish).
